text:
jamie.ops: Heads up — VendorPulse just pushed the ETA on PO#4839-RED (60 H100s) from ~6w -> ~10w due to customs congestion. Need plan B.

nora.procure: Yikes. Which regions are affected? do we have any EU/US pool to borrow from? @liam-ware? :eyes:

liam-ware: All lanes hit but vendor offered split: 30 via air (ETA 2w, extra cost) + 30 via sea (ETA 10w). Air needs AWB prep & export docs.

paul.vendor: Confirming — air option incurs ~$4.2k/unit uplift incl expedited broker fees. Can do 30/30 split, or smaller batches. Air slots limited next 10 days.

infra-sre: If we lose 60 H100s for 4-8 weeks our burst capacity for model serving drops ~28%. We should prioritize critical production clusters (eu-prod, us-realtime) vs. batch.

anna-ops: We have 12 depot RMAs currently unresolved (serial mismatches + DOA). If we clear those and re-certify, we can free ~10 usable units for short term. That reduces air need to ~20.

nora.procure: Good catch, Anna. What's the ETA to resolve RMAs? any customs docs holding them?

anna-ops: Depot needs vendor confirmation on serial reconciliation. I pinged vendor support this morning (ticket VP-9023). If vendor signs off, depot can re-label & ship in 3 business days. :ok_hand:

liam-ware: Engineering: can you accept temporary capacity shaping? We can reassign Dedicated pools to keep latency SLOs for priority routes if we must.

infra-sre: Yes — we can throttle non-critical tenants, move RL workloads to lower-cost quantized variants, and enable KV-cache warmup to reduce tokens. It will buy us ~2-3 weeks of headroom. Need approval though.

nora.procure: Budget note: approving 20 air units = ~$84k uplift. Approving 30 = ~$126k. Do we have discretionary? @jamie.ops can you confirm priority and cost center?

jamie.ops: OK to approve up to 20 for latency-sensitive clusters (us-realtime + eu-prod). Push for vendor sign-off on depot RMAs asap.

paul.vendor: I'll escalate serial reconciliation for VP-9023 and reserve 20 air slots tentatively. Need PO addendum to proceed and wire confirmation.

nora.procure: I'll draft addendum now and route for e-sign.

anna-ops: Action items: (1) vendor to sign off RMA serials (paul.vendor), (2) procurement addendum for 20 air units (nora), (3) infra to enact capacity shaping plan (infra-sre). I'll triage depot work to clear re-cert within 72 hours.

liam-ware: Also flagging customs brokerage code — air shipments require HS code 8471.80 and temp export license on a couple SKUs; vendor to confirm.

paul.vendor: Confirmed HS 8471.80 applies. We'll include broker paperwork with air AWB.

jamie.ops: Great. Keep updates here. If depot can't re-certify, we'll cut the addendum and push more units to air. :thumbsup:

nora.procure: Filed addendum draft, linking in thread: https://docs.internal/redwood/po-4839-addendum (will update once signed).

infra-sre: I'll prepare capacity-shaping runbook and post ETA for rollout in #eng-oncall.

anna-ops: I'll follow up with depot tomorrow AM and update VP-9023.

paul.vendor: Noted. Reserving 20 air slots for 72h pending PO addendum & wire.

jamie.ops: Thanks team. Closing loop once PO signed or depot confirmed.
